body:
We have requirements (2.10.x and 4.3.3) which seem like AuthN or access control really they come down to how the app interacts with external service.

I think it's therefore very important to move these into a dedicated section in the configuration chapter for accuracy and because I think they are causing confusion and distraction in their current chapters.
